# LucideIcon

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:lucide-icon` · Kerf UI · component · Foundation

## When to use

Decorative and meaningfully labeled Lucide-compatible icons.

- Render a decorative or explicitly labeled Lucide-compatible icon in Kerf application UI.

**Not when:**

- Do not use an icon as the only name of an unfamiliar action.

**Alternatives:**

- [Icon](./wa-icon.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/lucide-icon` — exports `LucideIcon`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/lucide-icon` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/lucide-icon.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/lucide-icon`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuilucide-icon) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** icon choice; meaningful label; optional foreground color.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: foundation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Decorative icons are aria-hidden; meaningful icons require a label.

## Usage examples

### Solid selected glyph

The solid appearance fills a compatible Lucide glyph with currentColor while retaining its stroke and accessible name policy.

```tsx
<LucideIcon icon={Star} name="star" appearance="solid" />
```

### Semantic icon color

Set an icon foreground with a semantic color token; omit color to inherit from surrounding text. Use foregroundColor() for a custom CSS color or foregroundColorVar() for an app variable.

```tsx
<LucideIcon icon={Bell} name="alert" color={uiColor('warning-on-quiet')} />
```

### Inline with text

Let a decorative icon flow inside Text or other prose while preserving its inherited 1em size.

```tsx
<Text>
  Ready <LucideIcon icon={Bell} name="notification" inline /> now.
</Text>
```

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
